list.tolerance: bit pattern / bool equal; field names and order equal

list.name: inclination_deg
list.definition: degrees(acos(-w_s / (1.5 n J2 (R_EARTH / a)^2))), a = R_EARTH + 1e3 alt, n = sqrt(MU / a^3), w_s = 2 pi / (365.25 * 86400)

list.name: status
list.definition: EVALUATED or the mapped status of the Python exception

tolerance_classes.EXACT_BYTES: files / serialized outputs byte-identical (sha256 equal); not used by this contract except where an observable says so
tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, statuses, error codes, schema shape, and floats that are copied (not computed): equal (floats compared by value, -0.0 == 0.0)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py) OR |rust - py| <= r_rel * |py| OR |rust - py| <= a_abs, with k_ulp / r_rel / a_abs fixed per observable below (an absent clause is not applied). The relative clause is scaled by |py|, NOT by max(1, |py|) as in the template's proposal: the observables span 1e-12 .. 1e17, so an absolute floor of r_rel would accept nonsense for small quantities; scaling by |py| is strictly tighter for |py| < 1 and identical otherwise. ulp(py) = 2^(floor(log2|py|) - 52) (py = 0: smallest subnormal)
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: not used (no RNG in either implementation; the harness RNG only draws input vectors)

tolerance_basis.independence: fixed before any comparison from the operation list
tolerance_basis.registered: k_ulp = 4 (template proposal): both implementations evaluate glibc pow / sqrt / acos (CPython float ** int and math.* call libm; Rust powf / sqrt / acos call the same libm) and IEEE basic operations in the same order; the only admissible difference is LLVM rewriting pow(x, 2.0) as x*x (correctly rounded) against glibc pow (< 1 ulp), i.e. <= 1 ulp of (R/a)^2, which acos near -0.11 maps to < 1 ulp of the result

It is NOT physics validation.
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
